inputs.description: Controls reasoning depth on the Gemini 3 models (Flash, Flash Lite, 3.7 Flash). 'none' disables thinking for lower latency and cost; higher levels improve accuracy on complex tasks and cost more. Ignored — and not billed — by every other model: Gemini 2.5 rejects the parameter, and the OpenAI and Anthropic models manage reasoning themselves with no per-level control.
